# Quill team -- ways of working

## Answering a direct question

If someone asks you a direct question in a shared channel, answer that
question. If you cannot answer it yet, say when you will. Answering a
different question is treated as not answering.

## Stating facts about the system

State what you have checked and what you are assuming. If you have not
verified something and someone may act on it, say so in the same message.

## Commitments on behalf of another team

Do not commit another team's dates or capacity. Ask them, then report their
answer with their name on it.

## Blocking replies

If someone says they are blocked on you, reply within two hours during working
hours, even if the reply is only that you need more time.

## Incidents

The person who finds a fault owns communicating it until someone else picks it
up. Say what is broken, what you have stopped, and what you still need
decided.
